longDescription:
## Purpose

The Product Title and Basic Info component displays essential product identification information at the top of the buy box. It provides customers with immediate recognition of what product they are viewing and which brand manufactures it.

## Use Cases

- Displaying product name prominently within the buy box
- Showing brand identity through name and optional logo
- Linking brand name to dedicated brand pages for brand discovery
- Reserving space for future rating summary integration

## Design Rationale

The component prioritizes product title visibility as the primary identifier while supporting optional brand elements. The brand logo option accommodates stores that emphasize brand partnerships, while the text-only brand name option suits simpler layouts. The modular design allows future extension with rating summaries without breaking existing implementations.
